hosts.reported_from: India, freshly felled wood; not a Chinese host

host_note: Original Indian collection was from recently felled Cedrus deodara, not healthy living trees. Chinese province and other host reports require separate source verification.

taxonomic_history.name: Crossotarsus coniferae
taxonomic_history.note: Stebbing (1906:411–412), Indian type locality in Tehri Garhwal.

nomenclature_note: Original Indian collection was from recently felled Cedrus deodara, not healthy living trees. Chinese province and other host reports require separate source verification.
